original:
मयस्तु विदिताभिप्रायः पार्थस्य परंतपः ।
चक्रे सभामनुपमां देवराजसभामिव ॥
sanskrit:
मयस्तु विदिताभिप्रायः पार्थस्य परंतपः ।
चक्रे सभामनुपमां देवराजसभामिव ॥
transliteration:
mayas tu viditābhiprāyaḥ pārthasya paraṃtapaḥ |
cakre sabhām anupamāṃ devarājasabhām iva ||
translation: Maya Danava, understanding the intention of Arjuna, constructed an incomparable assembly hall resembling the council hall of Indra.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: मय दानव ने अर्जुन के अभिप्राय को जानकर इंद्र की सभा के समान एक अनुपम और दिव्य सभा भवन का निर्माण किया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: मय दानवाने अर्जुनाचा मनोदय ओळखून इंद्राच्या सभेसारखी एक अनुपम व भव्य सभा निर्माण केली.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The construction of the Maya Sabha in Indraprastha marks the zenith of the Pandavas' temporal prosperity prior to the Rajasuya sacrifice.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: The assembly hall symbolizes the wondrous creation of cosmic Maya, reflecting optical illusions between land and water that foreshadowed the great conflict.
